purpose: Portable reconciliation of inherited landing-page quote candidates against preserved transcript text.

normalization.algorithm: Python html.unescape, lowercase, ASCII encode with non-ASCII dropped, then [a-z0-9']+ tokens.
normalization.match_rule: All contiguous token locations are retained. Character offsets index the HTML-unescaped, lowercase ASCII source text used by that matcher.
normalization.context_rule: Context spans are 180 matcher-source characters on either side where available; their SHA-256 hashes make the locator reproducible without reprinting transcript text.

limits: A transcript token trace does not certify that a caption is an exact record of spoken words.
A transcript token trace does not certify inherited speaker attribution or source title.
A transcript token trace does not certify current facts, causality, or claim truth.
Quantified conversion claims and benchmarks are practitioner claims only, never operating rules or expected outcomes.
Nested attributions remain inherited unless their primary source is separately verified.
Ellipses, composites, unmatched text, and rewrites remain unverified inherited traces.

original_quote_library.label_rule: Q001 through Q118 follow inherited quote-block reading order; original_line identifies the block start in the preserved original.

unknowns: No primary video/audio, platform caption export, creator metadata, publication date, or independent support for numerical claims was supplied in this preserved set.
